static_factors.label: Multi-factor susceptibility factors
static_factors.disclaimer: Relative screening from weather × landscape × infrastructure. Not inundation depth, not flood probability, not a calibrated hydrology model.
static_factors.citations_note: Compound flood-susceptibility indices commonly combine hazard intensity, land-surface predisposition (topography, imperviousness), and exposure/drainage; weights here are transparent screening defaults, not NYC-calibrated parameters.

inundation.dem_note: HAND/product on ~30 m working grid derived from USGS 3DEP metro ≤10 m mosaic; native 10 m DEM retained for SFINCS / nested hydro.

drainage_capacity_proxy.label: Open drainage capacity proxy (NLCD + optional drain density + mm/hr sink)
drainage_capacity_proxy.formula: capacity_mm_hr = (CAP_BASE + (CAP_MAX-CAP_BASE)*drain_norm) * (1 - α·impervious); intensity = precip/event_duration; efficiency = 1/(1 + k·max(0, intensity/capacity - 1)²); excess_precip_mm = precip_mm - min(precip, capacity·effective_drainage_hours·efficiency)
drainage_capacity_proxy.citations_note: Order-of-magnitude urban drainage design / pluvial screening sink rates (~5–25 mm/hr sustained; short-duration design often higher). Effective drainage hours ≪ full event length so storm-total screening does not over-credit conveyance. Not a calibrated NYC DEP network.

inundation.disclaimer: Primary research depth = unified pysheds HAND/bathtub on metro DEM forced by spatially varying MRMS QPE Ida after an open drainage capacity proxy (NLCD impervious + optional drain density + literature mm/hr sink with surcharge). NOT a DEP sewer model. Soft land mask (alpha/nodata outside land). NOT official NWS. NOT decision-grade. SFINCS is an alternate hydro track only.
inundation.label: pysheds HAND/bathtub (unified metro path)
inundation.formula: depth_m = max(rain_m − HAND, min(depression_sink, rain_m), rain_m − (DEM − focal_min)); rain_m = runoff_coeff * effective_precip_mm/1000; effective_precip from drainage_capacity_proxy_v1 when enabled
